title: 3-Hour Sail
specs: View eagles, great blue herons, seals, dolphins and occasionally whales
Sights include historic Fisgard Lighthouse, Naval harbour, Esquimalt Lagoon, Whitty’s Lagoon and Trial Island
Evening cruise sights include Victoria’s largest float home community and the First Nations Land And Sea mural
All ages and abilities welcome aboard
Accommodate groups up to 24 with special interests for customized trips

services.name: 3 Hour Sail
services.desc: Sights include Victoria’s largest float home community and the First Nations Land And Sea mural. You are welcome to bring along a picnic on your sail, as we do not have food available for purchase. There are many local restaurants near the dock which offer takeaway meals and snacks for your enjoyment. Alcohol is permitted on board (within reason). We have coolers, ice, glasses and bottle openers available for our guests. However, our sailings are family friendly - we are not a booze cruise! Be sure to arrive at least 15 minutes prior to departure. Departure times may vary slightly due to weather and special events in Victoria’s Inner

quotes.author: Steve Ellis
quotes.text: We had a great experience during our first time on a sailing boat. Capt Mike and Isabelle are impeccably qualified sailors and nautical pilots with a lifetime of sailing knowledge and experience. The entire 3 hours was made fun and educational and at all times safe. Capt Mike has many great stories and tells a fascinating history of the DUEN. Lots of opportunities to be a crew person whether hoisting the sails or stepping out along the bowsprit. All made fun by Isabelle and Capt Mike. Highly recommend.

quotes.author: Laura Chasmer
quotes.text: We had a wonderful sailing trip with Mike, Isabelle, and Dan on this historic vessel. Unlike other sailing trips we had been on, we actually sailed! The crew asked our kids and others to help them raise and lower the sails and taught us the lingo, how to tie off the ropes, and the history of the boat. It was truly a remarkable experience to remember! We fully recommend this to anyone visiting or living in Victoria.

quotes.author: "The Housse
quotes.text: What a wonderful experience! We took our team on the three hour day cruise, & everyone thoroughly enjoyed themselves! Captain Mike & First Mate Ryan were so pleasant & welcoming; even letting our team members join in some of the sailing activities. We took food & beverage on the boat with us, & enjoyed the glorious weather. I would highly recommend this activity. Thanks again Mike & Ryan. We will be back!

quotes.author: Kathi B
quotes.text: As we walked along the Victoria waterfront we saw the Duen docked and on a whim decided to book a sail for the next morning. We’re so glad we did! We had a wonderful 3 hour morning sail with Captain Mike and mate Rowan. They were professional, personable, and allowed us to join in on the sailing duties. We had a lovely morning with a great group of people.

quotes.author: MIke Hill
quotes.text: Wow. I did the sunset Cruise. The history of this boat is amazing we left the harbour and went out the inner harbour seeing the Cruise ships. Was Quiet and calm met lots people from all over the world on the boat lots of good conversations I would highly recommend this next time I’m gonna try to 3 hour sail

quotes.author: Laura McKenzie
quotes.text: Absolutely amazing! Breathtaking views and an incredible vessel with such an inspiring history. The Captain, Mike, and First Mate, Rowan, are the real deal and show their passion for sailing and for helping others. I would recommend everyone put this experience on their list when near Victoria!
